options.name: a10_device_context_id
options.description: Device ID for aVCS configuration

options.name: a10_partition
options.description: Destination/target partition for object/command

options.name: ansible_host
options.description: Host for AXAPI authentication

options.name: ansible_password
options.description: Password for AXAPI authentication

options.name: ansible_port
options.description: Port for AXAPI authentication

options.name: ansible_username
options.description: Username for AXAPI authentication

options.name: dn
options.description: Specify the Distinguished-Name to use while enrolling the certificate (Format= 'cn=user, dc=example, dc=com')

options.name: encrypted
options.description: Do NOT use this option manually. (This is an A10 reserved keyword.) (The ENCRYPTED secret string)

options.name: enroll
options.description: Initiates enrollment of device with the CA

options.name: interval
options.description: Interval time in seconds to poll when SCEP response is PENDING (default 5)

options.name: key_length
options.description: '1024'= Key size 1024 bits; '2048'= Key size 2048 bits(default); '4096'= Key size 4096 bits; '8192'= Key size 8192 bits;

options.name: log_level
options.description: level for logging output of scepclient commands(default 1 and detailed 4)

options.name: max_polltime
options.description: Maximum time in seconds to poll when SCEP response is PENDING (default 180)

options.name: method
options.description: 'GET'= GET request; 'POST'= POST request;

options.name: minute
options.description: Periodic interval in minutes

options.name: name
options.description: Specify Certificate name to be enrolled

options.name: password
options.description: Specify the password used to enroll the device's certificate

options.name: renew_before
options.description: Specify interval before certificate expiry to renew the certificate

options.name: renew_before_type
options.description: 'hour'= Number of hours before cert expiry; 'day'= Number of days before cert expiry; 'week'= Number of weeks before cert expiry; 'month'= Number of months before cert expiry(1 month=30 days);

options.name: renew_before_value
options.description: Value of renewal period

options.name: renew_every
options.description: Specify periodic interval in which to renew the certificate

options.name: renew_every_type
options.description: 'hour'= Periodic interval in hours; 'day'= Periodic interval in days; 'week'= Periodic interval in weeks; 'month'= Periodic interval in months(1 month=30 days);

options.name: renew_every_value
options.description: Value of renewal period

options.name: secret_string
options.description: secret password

options.name: state
options.description: State of the object to be created.

options.name: subject_alternate_name
options.description: Field subject_alternate_name

options.name: url
options.description: Specify the Enrollment Agent's absolute URL (Format= http=//host/path)

options.name: user_tag
options.description: Customized tag

options.name: uuid
options.description: uuid of the object
